title: Government documents describe metallic, reflective, flat-bottomed objects

tellings.quote: These documents include the 1947 Twining memo, the 1948 Project Sign analysis, and the CIA's analysis of the 1952 DC UFO flyover, along with Blue Book lead Captain Edward J. Ruppelt's analysis and more.

plain: Official US documents from 1947 to 1952 describe UFOs as metallic, reflective and flat-bottomed, Michels says on his own account. He lists the Twining memo, titled AMC Opinion Concerning "Flying Discs" and written on 23 September 1947 by the Air Materiel Command of the US Army Air Forces, alongside a 1948 analysis by Project Sign, an early Air Force UFO study. He also lists a CIA analysis of the 1952 UFO flyover of Washington, DC, and the analysis of Captain Edward J. Ruppelt, who led Blue Book, the US Air Force's UFO study of the 1950s and 60s.
